_comment: Balíček kolekcí V4.4.4 – kinematografie zemí (Korea, Itálie, Francie, Indie, Hongkong, Španělsko a Latinská Amerika, Německo, Severské země) a 33 režisérů (Soderbergh, Spike Lee, Zemeckis, Ron Howard, Boyle, Ritchie, Aronofsky, Lanthimos, Sofia Coppola, Linklater, Shyamalan, Bay, Emmerich, Gilliam, Stone, Reiner, Brooks, Rodriguez, Craven, Flanagan, Besson, von Trier, Haneke, Malick, Cuarón, Iñárritu, Waititi, Kore-eda, Zhang Yimou, Ang Lee, Menzel, Chytilová, Lipský, Vorlíček). Přidá se do seedu příkazem ./scripts/add-pack.sh supabase/packs/v4.4.4-world-directors.json (nové kolekce na konec seedu), pak se importuje. Bez migrace.

films.title: Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In

universes.name: Spanish & Latin American Cinema
universes.description: From The Spirit of the Beehive to City of God and Society of the Snow – Spanish-language and Brazilian cinema.

universes.description: Dogme, Nordic noir and dark humour from Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland.

films.title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
The Worst Person in the World

universes.name: Japanese Cinema
universes.description: Live-action Japan beyond Kurosawa – Mizoguchi, samurai, Takeshi Kitano, Battle Royale and Perfect Days.

universes.name: British Cinema
universes.description: Ealing comedies, Powell & Pressburger, kitchen-sink realism and Richard Curtis – a century of British film.

universes.description: Heists, pandemics and indie experiments – from sex, lies, and videotape to Black Bag.

universes.name: Spike Lee
universes.description: Brooklyn, race and righteous anger – Do the Right Thing, Malcolm X, Inside Man, BlacKkKlansman.

universes.name: Robert Zemeckis
universes.description: Time machines, toons and a man on a bench – Back to the Future, Roger Rabbit, Forrest Gump, Cast Away.

films.title: Back to the Future Part II
Back to the Future Part III

universes.name: Ron Howard
universes.description: Houston, we have a problem – Splash, Apollo 13, A Beautiful Mind, Rush and five decades of crowd-pleasers.

films.title: In the Heart of the Sea

universes.name: Danny Boyle
universes.description: Choose life – Trainspotting, 28 Days Later, Slumdog Millionaire and 28 Years Later.

universes.name: Guy Ritchie
universes.description: Diamonds, dogs and cockney gangsters – Lock, Stock, Snatch, Sherlock Holmes and The Gentlemen.

films.title: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels
Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
King Arthur: Legend of the Sword

universes.name: Darren Aronofsky
universes.description: Obsession to the point of breaking – Requiem for a Dream, Black Swan, The Whale.

universes.name: Yorgos Lanthimos
universes.description: Deadpan, deeply strange and very funny – Dogtooth, The Lobster, The Favourite, Poor Things.

films.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer

universes.name: Sofia Coppola
universes.description: Lonely girls in gilded cages – The Virgin Suicides, Lost in Translation, Marie Antoinette, Priscilla.

universes.name: Richard Linklater
universes.description: Talking, walking and time passing – the Before trilogy, Dazed and Confused, School of Rock and Boyhood.

universes.name: M. Night Shyamalan
universes.description: I see dead people – twists, aliens and superheroes in Philadelphia, from The Sixth Sense to Trap.

universes.name: Michael Bay
universes.description: Explosions, sunsets and slow-motion heroes – Bad Boys, The Rock, Armageddon and Transformers.

films.title: 13 Hours: The Secret Soldiers of Benghazi

universes.name: Roland Emmerich
universes.description: The master of disaster – Stargate, Independence Day, The Day After Tomorrow and 2012.

universes.name: Terry Gilliam
universes.description: Monty Python's animator gone wild – Time Bandits, Brazil, 12 Monkeys and Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas.

films.title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
films.label: with Terry Jones

films.title: Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas
The Man Who Killed Don Quixote

universes.name: Oliver Stone
universes.description: Vietnam, Wall Street and American presidents – Platoon, JFK, Natural Born Killers.

films.title: Born on the Fourth of July

universes.name: Rob Reiner
universes.description: From Spinal Tap to The Princess Bride, When Harry Met Sally... and Misery – a run of classics in every genre.

films.title: Spinal Tap II: The End Continues

universes.name: Mel Brooks
universes.description: Springtime for Hitler and Young Frankenstein – the king of spoofs, from The Producers to Spaceballs.

films.title: History of the World: Part I

universes.name: Robert Rodriguez
universes.description: A one-man film crew – El Mariachi, From Dusk Till Dawn, Sin City and Spy Kids.

films.title: Spy Kids 2: The Island of Lost Dreams
Once Upon a Time in Mexico
The Adventures of Sharkboy and Lavagirl
Spy Kids: All the Time in the World
Sin City: A Dame to Kill For

universes.name: Wes Craven
universes.description: Freddy Krueger, Ghostface and the rules of horror – the master who kept reinventing the genre.

films.title: The Last House on the Left

universes.name: Mike Flanagan
universes.description: Horror with a broken heart – Oculus, Gerald's Game, Doctor Sleep and The Life of Chuck.

universes.name: Luc Besson
universes.description: Assassins, divers and blue opera singers – Nikita, Léon, The Fifth Element and Lucy.

films.title: The Messenger: The Story of Joan of Arc
The Extraordinary Adventures of Adèle Blanc-Sec
Valerian and the City of a Thousand Planets

universes.name: Lars von Trier
universes.description: Dogme, depression and provocation – Breaking the Waves, Dancer in the Dark, Dogville, Melancholia.

universes.name: Michael Haneke
universes.description: Cold, precise and unforgettable – Funny Games, The Piano Teacher, Caché, Amour.

films.title: 71 Fragments of a Chronology of Chance

universes.name: Terrence Malick
universes.description: Whispered voice-overs and golden-hour light – Badlands, Days of Heaven, The Thin Red Line, The Tree of Life.

universes.name: Alfonso Cuarón
universes.description: Long takes and big hearts – Y Tu Mamá También, Prisoner of Azkaban, Children of Men, Gravity, Roma.

films.title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban

universes.name: Alejandro G. Iñárritu
universes.description: Lives that collide – Amores Perros, Babel, Birdman and The Revenant.

films.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

universes.name: Taika Waititi
universes.description: Kiwi comedy with heart – What We Do in the Shadows, Hunt for the Wilderpeople, Thor: Ragnarok, Jojo Rabbit.

films.title: What We Do in the Shadows

universes.name: Hirokazu Kore-eda
universes.description: Families we're born into and families we choose – Nobody Knows, Still Walking, Shoplifters.

universes.name: Zhang Yimou
universes.description: Red lanterns and flying daggers – from Red Sorghum to Hero and Full River Red.

universes.name: Ang Lee
universes.description: From Taipei kitchens to Brokeback Mountain and Life of Pi – every genre, always human.

universes.name: Tony Scott
universes.description: Saturated colours and adrenaline – Top Gun, True Romance, Crimson Tide, Man on Fire and Unstoppable.

universes.name: Kathryn Bigelow
universes.description: Surfers, soldiers and spies – Point Break, The Hurt Locker, Zero Dark Thirty, the first woman to win Best Director.

universes.name: John Woo
universes.description: Two guns, slow motion and white doves – from A Better Tomorrow and Hard Boiled to Face/Off.

universes.name: Jane Campion
universes.description: Desire, repression and wild landscapes – An Angel at My Table, The Piano, The Power of the Dog.

universes.name: Martin McDonagh
universes.description: Pitch-black comedy with a conscience – In Bruges, Seven Psychopaths, Three Billboards, The Banshees of Inisherin.

universes.name: Abbas Kiarostami
universes.description: Cars, roads and the line between fiction and life – Close-Up, Taste of Cherry, Certified Copy.

universes.name: Jiří Menzel
universes.description: Gentle humour and Hrabal – Oscar-winning Closely Watched Trains, Cutting It Short, I Served the King of England.

films.title: Život a neobyčejná dobrodružství vojáka Ivana Čonkina

universes.name: Věra Chytilová
universes.description: The rebel of the Czechoslovak New Wave – Daisies, Panelstory and sharp satire to the very end.

films.title: Panelstory aneb Jak se rodí sídliště

universes.name: Oldřich Lipský
universes.description: Czech parody at its best – Lemonade Joe, Dinner for Adele, Jáchyme, hoď ho do stroje!

universes.name: Václav Vorlíček
universes.description: Fairy tales and fantastic comedies – Three Wishes for Cinderella, Who Wants to Kill Jessie?, Saxana.
